subject: Sewer repair stuck in review
issue: The landlord in our building is waiting on a plan check for a sewer repair, and the city has no published timeline for it. Every week the sewer line stays broken is another week our bathroom does not work.
detail: The staff at the counter said the reviewer has a backlog of about two hundred files, and that is the reason. We are asking for more reviewers so these basic repairs stop dragging on.
ask: Please add plan checkers and publish turnaround times for repair permits like sewer work.
actionable_reason: Sewer permit stalled; staffing request

subject: Warehouse review skips air quality
issue: The environmental review for the proposed warehouse near us only studied traffic and says nothing about the diesel trucks idling at night.
ask: Please require a full air quality study before the council votes on the warehouse.
actionable_reason: Missing air quality study for trucks

subject: Outdated water study for new homes
issue: The developers of the housing complex next to us used an old water study from before the drought, and nobody has checked whether the aquifer can handle the new units.
detail: The older homes on our street already report low pressure in the summer.
ask: Please order an updated water supply analysis that reflects current drought conditions.
actionable_reason: Outdated water study; needs updated analysis

subject: Gas station soil and traffic gaps
issue: The gas station rebuild proposed across from my house would add two extra fuel canopies and a convenience store, but the traffic study counted cars only on a Tuesday morning. The soil testing only covers the front half of the lot, not where the old underground tanks were.
detail: Anyone who drives this stretch knows the Tuesday counts miss the school rush and the weekend tourist traffic. I want the city to require borings under the old tank area before any approval.
ask: Please require a full environmental review with soil borings and weekend traffic counts before approval.
actionable_reason: Incomplete soil and traffic studies

subject: Estudio de aire del almacén
issue: El estudio ambiental del nuevo almacén cerca de nosotros no mide el polvo ni el ruido de los camiones de noche.
ask: Pido que la ciudad exija un estudio completo de calidad del aire antes de aprobarlo.
actionable_reason: Falta estudio de aire y ruido

subject: Restaurant worried about generators
issue: I own a restaurant two blocks from the proposed data center, and the environmental review does not address the backup generators at all. Testing them could mean monthly diesel noise and exhaust.
detail: Customers already complain about freeway noise, and I cannot afford another source.
ask: Please require the review to analyze generator emissions and testing schedules before the project moves forward.
actionable_reason: Generator emissions missing from review

subject: Đánh giá bỏ sót bụi và ồn
issue: Báo cáo đánh giá môi trường cho dự án nhà ở gần nhà tôi chỉ đo lưu lượng xe vào buổi sáng, chưa xét đến tiếng ồn và bụi xây dựng.
detail: Gia đình tôi có người già và trẻ nhỏ, nên bụi và tiếng ồn ảnh hưởng nhiều.
ask: Mong thành phố yêu cầu bổ sung đo bụi và tiếng ồn trước khi phê duyệt.
actionable_reason: Thiếu đo bụi và tiếng ồn

subject: Wetlands claim doesn't match
issue: The environmental report says the rezoned parcel has no wetlands, but I have seen standing water there every spring.
ask: Please have the city recheck the wetlands delineation before approving the rezoning.
actionable_reason: Wetlands claim conflicts with spring observations

subject: Dust from apartment construction
issue: The study for the new apartment block near our building looked at hazardous soil but not construction dust, which would blow directly into our windows. Our kids have asthma.
detail: Construction could go on for two years, and we have no idea who will check the dust controls.
ask: Please require a dust and construction noise plan with enforceable limits for the apartment project.
actionable_reason: Dust and noise plan needed for construction

subject: Truck routes missing from review
issue: The review for the rezoned parcel near our shop left out truck routes, and our delivery vans would have to use the same narrow road.
ask: Please ask the applicant to add a truck route analysis before the hearing.
actionable_reason: Truck route analysis missing from review

subject: Estación de gasolina sin estudio de suelo
issue: La estación de gasolina que quieren construir enfrente de mi casa necesita revisar el suelo, pero el estudio solo llega hasta el frente del terreno. Hay tanques viejos que nadie ha revisado.
detail: Mi esposa tiene problemas de los pulmones y no quiero que el vapor de gasolina nos afecte.
ask: Pido que la ciudad exija análisis del subsuelo en todo el terreno antes de aprobar el proyecto.
actionable_reason: Estudio de suelo incompleto; tanques viejos

subject: Air monitor too far from site
issue: The developer's air study for the new apartment complex used data from a monitor six miles away, not from the lot itself. The truck route in the report goes right past the playground where my daughter's school lets out.
detail: We already breathe dust from the freeway, and I am not sure this report accounts for that. A new monitor placed on the site would give us real numbers.
ask: Please require an air monitor on the site and a corrected truck route analysis before approval.
actionable_reason: Air data from distant monitor; truck route

subject: Kho hàng và xe tải ban đêm
issue: Tôi thuê nhà gần khu đất sắp xây kho hàng, nhưng báo cáo môi trường không hề nói đến xe tải chạy đêm.
ask: Mong thành phố yêu cầu bổ sung đánh giá về xe tải chạy đêm trước khi duyệt.
actionable_reason: Báo cáo bỏ sót xe tải ban đêm

subject: Dry-year water supply unclear
issue: The data center review lists a cooling water figure but does not say where the water comes from during a dry year. I would like to understand the plan before I form an opinion.
detail: I have no problem with new jobs, but I want the numbers to hold up.
ask: Please publish the water source and dry-year supply plan for the data center.
actionable_reason: Dry-year water source not disclosed

subject: Agua para el desarrollo nuevo
issue: El desarrollo de vivienda nuevo cerca de nosotros no incluye un estudio de agua, y solo dicen que el agua de los pozos vecinos no se afectará. Nadie nos ha mostrado cómo lo comprobaron.
detail: Varios vecinos ya tienen agua con poca presión en el verano.
ask: Pido que la ciudad exija un estudio de agua actualizado antes de aprobar el proyecto.
actionable_reason: Sin estudio de agua verificable

subject: No noise data for nearby homes
issue: The appendix on noise in the warehouse report has no measurements from our side of the street.
ask: Please require noise measurements at the nearest homes before the hearing.
actionable_reason: No noise measurements at nearby homes

subject: Upstream subdivision will worsen drains
issue: The new subdivision upstream would pave over the last open field, and I am worried the storm drains on our street cannot handle the runoff.
detail: Our basement flooded twice in the last five years, and both times the water came up through the storm drain.
ask: Please require a drainage study that models a 100-year storm with the new paved surfaces.
actionable_reason: Drainage study missing for storm runoff

subject: Creek flooding on our street
issue: Every time the creek rises, our street gets water up to the curb, and the proposed warehouse would cover more ground.
ask: Please require the developer to show how the site will drain without adding water to our street.
actionable_reason: Warehouse runoff could worsen street flooding

subject: Proyecto nuevo y charcos
issue: Si construyen el proyecto nuevo de vivienda, el agua de lluvia va a bajar directo a las casas de abajo. Ya hay charcos cada vez que llueve fuerte.
detail: Mi sótano se inundó en 2019 y nadie del gobierno nos explicó por qué.
ask: Pido que la ciudad revise el plan de drenaje y exija bombas o tanques de retención.
actionable_reason: Plan de drenaje insuficiente; charcos frecuentes

subject: Car wash worried about runoff
issue: As the owner of a small car wash near the proposed data center site, I am worried the project could change how water drains down our block. Our wash already loses a day's business after heavy rain.
detail: We would lose money every time the lot floods, and the neighbors would be stuck too.
ask: Please require the project to include stormwater retention and show how the lot will drain.
actionable_reason: Stormwater plan needed to protect block

subject: Đất trũng và nước ngập
issue: Khu đất mới được đổi sang xây nhà ở cách nhà tôi không xa, mà phần đất này trước đây là ruộng thấp nên nước dễ đọng. Nếu lát bê tông hết, nước sẽ tràn về phía nhà chúng tôi.
detail: Mùa mưa năm ngoái nước đã ngập đến hiên nhà, và chúng tôi phải dọn đồ lên gác. Tôi lo dự án này sẽ làm tình trạng ngập tệ hơn.
ask: Mong thành phố yêu cầu nhà đầu tư xây hồ chứa nước mưa và chứng minh không gây ngập.
actionable_reason: Đất trũng; yêu cầu hồ chứa nước mưa

subject: Culvert clogs behind apartments
issue: The rezoned parcel behind our apartment has a culvert that clogs every year, and nobody says what happens to it once the lot is built. Our unit is on the ground floor.
detail: Last spring the parking lot filled with water and two cars were stuck in it.
ask: Please require an inspection of the culvert and a plan to keep runoff off our property.
actionable_reason: Clogged culvert; runoff plan missing

subject: Upstream paving adds runoff
issue: Paving the lot upstream would send more runoff straight into the drain that already backs up.
ask: Please require stormwater retention before the project gets a permit.
actionable_reason: Upstream paving worsens existing drain backups

subject: Agua del pozo en riesgo
issue: Nos preocupa que el agua del pozo baje si construyen todas esas casas nuevas en la zona.
ask: Pido que la ciudad exija un estudio del agua subterránea antes de aprobar el proyecto.
actionable_reason: Riesgo de agua subterránea sin estudio

subject: Data center groundwater draw
issue: The proposed data center plans to pull groundwater for cooling, and the report only says the impact will be 'minimal.' Nobody has told us what minimal means for the wells that homes on our street still use.
detail: Our neighbor's well went dry in 2022 during the drought, and the county never investigated. Once a project draws from the same layer, the impact is hard to undo.
ask: Please require the developer to quantify groundwater draw and commit to recycled water for cooling.
actionable_reason: Groundwater impact unquantified; wells at risk

subject: Summer water pressure dropping
issue: I rent a unit close to the proposed housing site, and the water pressure already drops every summer when the neighbors water their lawns. Adding a hundred new units could make it worse for all of us.
detail: I called the water department twice about low pressure, and they told me to run the tap in the morning.
ask: Please require the city to confirm water supply capacity before the housing project is approved.
actionable_reason: Summer water pressure already dropping

subject: Truck trips missing from traffic count
issue: The proposed warehouse would add about four hundred truck trips a day on our two-lane road, and the traffic report counted only passenger cars.
ask: Please require the traffic study to count truck trips and include our street in the analysis.
actionable_reason: Traffic study ignores truck trips

subject: No parking on our street
issue: Our street already has no parking after six o'clock because of the apartments, and the new building would bring another hundred residents with cars.
detail: People park across our driveways and block the mailboxes, and there is no plan to deal with it.
ask: Please require the developer to provide on-site parking or a parking permit plan before approval.
actionable_reason: Parking shortage will worsen on street

subject: Tòa nhà cao gây bóng râm
issue: Tòa nhà mới cao tám tầng sẽ che hết ánh nắng cho sân sau nhà tôi, và đường trước nhà đã kẹt xe mỗi giờ tan tầm.
detail: Vợ tôi trồng rau trong sân và đã mất gần hết mùa vì bóng râm.
ask: Mong thành phố giảm chiều cao tòa nhà hoặc yêu cầu lùi đường xây về sau để bớt bóng râm.
actionable_reason: Chiều cao gây bóng râm và kẹt xe

subject: Storefront vacancies on main street
issue: We have seven vacant storefronts on the main street already, and the new mixed-use project would add four more empty spaces that might never lease. It feels like the block is losing its character one closed shop at a time.
detail: The old hardware store and two restaurants have closed in the last three years. I would like the city to require tenant-ready retail before any new space is approved.
ask: Please require a retail leasing plan with local tenants before approving any new ground-floor space.
actionable_reason: Retail leasing plan required before approval

subject: Tráfico escolar sin estudiar
issue: Con el edificio nuevo habrá muchísimos más carros en la calle y la escuela ya tiene problemas con el tráfico a la salida.
ask: Pido que la ciudad revise el tráfico en horas de escuela antes de aprobar el proyecto.
actionable_reason: Tráfico escolar no evaluado en estudio

subject: Five-story building next to homes
issue: The developer wants a five-story building right next to a single-family street, and the zoning would let them block our afternoon sun. We are not against housing, just against a building that size in the middle of a quiet block.
detail: Our homes are one and two stories, and the new building would tower over the back fences.
ask: Please keep the height limit at three stories along our side of the street.
actionable_reason: Five-story height exceeds nearby homes

subject: Neighborhood changing too fast
issue: I just don't like how fast the area is changing. There used to be a family-owned bakery and a shoe repair place here.
ask: Please consider neighborhood character when the council reviews the project.
actionable_reason: General opinion on neighborhood change

subject: 小餐馆与停车压力
issue: 我在这条街上经营一家小餐馆，新的住宅楼如果建成，门口的停车位会更加紧张，外卖和送货车也会堵在路上。
detail: 每到周末晚上，街口已经排了很长的车，顾客经常找不到车位。
ask: 希望城市在审批前评估停车和送货车的影响，并要求开发商提供停车方案。
actionable_reason: 停车和送货车影响未评估

subject: Building too tall for street
issue: The building is too tall for the street, and it feels out of place next to our one-story homes.
ask: Please ask the design review board to reconsider the height.
actionable_reason: Opinion on height; no specific data

subject: Speeding cars on side street
issue: Cars already speed down our side street to avoid the light, and the proposed apartments would send another few hundred trips onto it. Kids on bikes have almost been hit twice this year.
detail: I reported it to traffic engineering, and they said the speed bumps are on a waiting list.
ask: Please require traffic calming on our street as part of the project approval.
actionable_reason: Speeding traffic; near misses reported

subject: Entregas en el terreno comercial
issue: Quieren cambiar el terreno a uso comercial y eso significa camiones de entrega todo el día frente a nuestras casas. Ya hay ruido y basura desde que cerró la tienda vieja.
detail: Mi mamá vive sola y ya no puede cruzar la calle por el tráfico de los fines de semana.
ask: Pido que la ciudad limite los horarios de entrega y revise el impacto en la calle antes de aprobar el cambio.
actionable_reason: Entregas diarias y tráfico sin revisar

subject: Unsafe left-turn lane at corner
issue: The left-turn pocket at the corner has no signal timing for the morning rush, so drivers cut across our driveway.
ask: Please have traffic engineering re-time the signal before any new trips are added.
actionable_reason: Signal timing unsafe; driveway conflicts

subject: Thiếu chỗ đậu xe
issue: Lối đi trước khu nhà chúng tôi đã không còn chỗ đậu xe sau 6 giờ tối, nay thêm tòa nhà mới thì càng chật.
ask: Mong thành phố yêu cầu chủ dự án có kế hoạch chỗ đậu xe ngay trong khu đất.
actionable_reason: Thiếu chỗ đậu xe sau giờ tối

subject: Truck deliveries down narrow alley
issue: The new mixed-use plan would send delivery trucks down the alley behind our apartments starting at five every morning. The alley is only one lane, and two residents have already had cars scraped when trucks squeeze through.
detail: We have complained to the property office and were told the truck route is 'not finalized.' I think the city should set the route before approving anything that depends on it.
ask: Please require a fixed truck route and delivery hours in the approval.
actionable_reason: Narrow alley; truck deliveries unsafe

subject: On-ramp backups at rush hour
issue: The planned apartments are near the freeway on-ramp, and the study ignores how backed up the ramp gets at rush hour. Adding a few hundred cars there will likely mean longer waits for everyone trying to get home.
detail: I drive that ramp every day, and it is already a fifteen-minute wait. I would like the traffic study to model the actual peak-hour backup, not just average counts.
ask: Please require a peak-hour traffic analysis at the on-ramp before the project is approved.
actionable_reason: Peak-hour ramp backups excluded from study

subject: Support townhomes with sidewalk access
issue: I support the new townhome project on the empty parcel, as long as the builder keeps the sidewalk open during construction.
ask: Please make sidewalk closures a permit condition, with daily noise and dust limits.
actionable_reason: Sidewalk access and construction limits required

subject: General support for mixed-use
issue: Overall I think a mixed-use building would be good for the corner, and I would rather see it than another vacant lot.
detail: I am not going to pretend I have all the technical answers, but I trust the planning staff to set fair conditions.
ask: Please approve it only after the conditions on parking and shade are written into the permit.
actionable_reason: General support; no specific problem raised

subject: Suporta sa pabahay na proyekto
issue: Suportado ko ang bagong proyekto ng pabahay sa lote malapit sa amin, basta may malinaw na tuntunin para sa ingay at trapiko.
detail: Gusto ko lang masiguro na hindi aabalahin ang mga batang pumapasok sa paaralan tuwing umaga.
ask: Sana ay isama ng lungsod ang oras ng konstruksyon at limitasyon sa ingay sa permit.
actionable_reason: Suporta kung may limitasyon sa ingay

subject: Warehouse expansion with local hiring
issue: We would support the warehouse expansion if the developer agrees to hire locally for at least a third of the construction jobs.
detail: Our neighborhood has a lot of skilled trades workers who are out of work right now.
ask: Please write the local hiring commitment into the approval with quarterly reporting.
actionable_reason: Local hiring commitment needed for approval

subject: Apoyo con vivienda accesible
issue: Apoyo el proyecto de vivienda si reservan una parte para familias de ingreso bajo.
ask: Pido que la ciudad ponga esa condición por escrito en el permiso.
actionable_reason: Apoyo con reserva de vivienda accesible

subject: Support housing with recycled water
issue: I support the new park-and-housing plan as long as the developer uses recycled water for landscaping.
ask: Please require recycled water for landscaping and irrigation as a condition of approval.
actionable_reason: Recycled water condition for landscaping

subject: Ủng hộ chung cư có điều kiện
issue: Tôi ủng hộ dự án chung cư mới nếu chủ đầu tư giới hạn giờ thi công đến 6 giờ chiều và giữ đường đi bộ an toàn.
detail: Trẻ con trong khu phố đi học qua đây mỗi ngày nên tôi rất quan tâm.
ask: Mong thành phố đưa điều kiện giờ thi công và đường đi bộ vào giấy phép.
actionable_reason: Điều kiện giờ thi công và an toàn

subject: Bike lanes and crosswalk funding
issue: I'm for the new bike lanes and two-story condos on the lot if the builder pays for the new crosswalk.
ask: Please require the developer to fund the crosswalk before occupancy.
actionable_reason: Developer-funded crosswalk before occupancy

subject: Construction hours for new housing
issue: I want the new housing to happen, but only with a noise schedule that keeps construction out of early mornings.
ask: Please write a construction hours limit into the permit for the lot near us.
actionable_reason: Construction hours limit requested in permit

subject: Mixed-use with height cap
issue: The proposed mixed-use building could bring needed shops, but only if it is sized to fit the block and the developer commits to ground-floor retail that stays open. Right now the plan calls for empty storefronts, which is exactly what we already have too many of.
detail: I would support it with a cap on height and a commitment to local tenants for the storefronts. Otherwise I would rather the lot wait for a better plan.
ask: Please approve it only with a height limit and a local-tenant leasing commitment for ground-floor retail.
actionable_reason: Height cap and local retail conditions
